user.title: Connect to Radiate
user.description: Enter the address of your Radiate server. If you installed the Radiate app in Home Assistant, it is found automatically.

data_description.url: Address and port of the Radiate server, as shown in its logs.
data_description.token: Leave empty if the server has no token set

hassio_confirm.title: Radiate app found
hassio_confirm.description: Add the Radiate app running on this Home Assistant?

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Radiate server. Check the URL and that it is running.

abort.already_configured: This Radiate house is already set up.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Radiate app.

duration_needed.message: Give a duration in minutes when the override ends after a duration.

duration_conflict.message: A duration only applies when the override ends after a duration.

boost_store.name: Boost hot water
boost_store.description: Turn the hot-water store on for a while, outside its schedule.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long to boost, up to 180 minutes.

set_mode.name: Set heating mode
set_mode.description: Auto follows schedules. Frost holds every room at the frost threshold. Off stops heating but keeps frost protection.

set_override.name: Set override
set_override.description: Hold a room at a temperature until its next scheduled change, for a number of minutes, or until you clear it.

until.name: Until
until.description: When the override ends. Leave it empty to end at the next scheduled change, or set a duration.

duration_min.name: Duration
duration_min.description: How long to hold the setpoint, in minutes, up to 7 days.

clear_override.name: Clear override
clear_override.description: Return a room to its schedule.
